settings.section_hint: Choose who can join ClickFix with a new account.
settings.mode.open.title: Sign-up open
settings.mode.open.body: Anyone can open an account and an organization at /register and starts with a trial.
settings.mode.invite.title: Invitation only
settings.mode.invite.body: New accounts are opened only through invitation links. Teams can invite their own members.
settings.mode.closed.title: Closed
settings.mode.closed.body: Only invitations sent by a platform admin open accounts. Team invitations work with existing accounts.
settings.admin_note: Platform admins can still create organizations while sign-up is closed.
invitation.registration_closed: Sign-up is closed at the moment, so this invitation can't open a new account. If you already have an account, sign in; otherwise talk to the person who invited you.
closed.title: ClickFix is currently invitation only
closed.body: New accounts are opened by invitation for now. Let's set up a short demo so you can see ClickFix with your team.
closed.invite_hint: The link in your invitation e-mail takes you straight to creating your account. If you already have one, sign in.
pitch.headline: Bring all your customer support into one place
pitch.subline: WhatsApp, e-mail, web chat and social media in one inbox; AI drafts the first replies for you.
pitch.step.account.title: Open your account
pitch.step.account.body: Your name, work e-mail and company name are all it takes.
pitch.step.verify.title: Verify your e-mail
pitch.step.verify.body: Enter the 6-digit code we send to your inbox.
pitch.step.organization.title: Your organization opens
pitch.step.organization.body: You start right away with the trial of the plan you picked.
pitch.step.setup.title: Finish set-up with AI
pitch.step.setup.body: Answer a few questions and get channels, teams and rules prepared for you.
